From 82a5cc783d49b86afd2f60e297ecd85223c39f88 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Konstantin Taranov <kotaranov@microsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Jun 2024 01:16:08 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/mana_ib: Ignore optional access flags for MRs

Ignore optional ib_access_flags when an MR is created.

Fixes: 0266a177631d ("RDMA/mana_ib: Add a driver for Microsoft Azure Network Adapter")
Signed-off-by: Konstantin Taranov <kotaranov@microsoft.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/1717575368-14879-1-git-send-email-kotaranov@linux.microsoft.com
Signed-off-by: Leon Romanovsky <leon@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c
index 4f13423ecdbd..887b09dd86e7 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c
@@ -112,6 +112,7 @@ struct ib_mr *mana_ib_reg_user_mr(struct ib_pd *ibpd, u64 start, u64 length,
 		  "start 0x%llx, iova 0x%llx length 0x%llx access_flags 0x%x",
 		  start, iova, length, access_flags);
 
+	access_flags &= ~IB_ACCESS_OPTIONAL;
 	if (access_flags & ~VALID_MR_FLAGS)
 		return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/mr.c`**
   - A new line was added to modify the `access_flags` variable by masking out the optional access flags. Specifically, the line `access_flags &= ~IB_ACCESS_OPTIONAL;` was introduced before the validation of the `access_flags`. This change ensures that any optional access flags are ignored when a memory region (MR) is created.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `mr.c` directly addresses a bug related to the handling of optional access flags during the creation of memory regions in the RDMA/mana_ib driver. By ignoring these optional flags, the patch aims to improve the correctness of the driver, which was previously affected by the inclusion of these flags as indicated by the fix reference to commit `0266a177631d`. This change enhances the stability and reliability of the memory registration process in the driver.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
access_flags & ~VALID_MR_FLAGS
mr_params.gva.access_flags = mana_ib_verbs_to_gdma_access_flags(access_flags);
```
Reason:
The inclusion of optional access flags in the memory region (MR) creation process allowed invalid configurations when these flags were not applicable. This could lead to errors or unexpected behavior since the driver was not designed to handle these optional flags correctly.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
access_flags &= ~IB_ACCESS_OPTIONAL;
if (access_flags & ~VALID_MR_FLAGS)
```
Reason:
By masking out the optional access flags before proceeding with the MR creation, the code ensures that only valid access flags are considered, preventing invalid configurations and ensuring that the driver operates as intended without errors related to unsupported flags.
